## The review changes the center of gravity

The attached material supports a more convincing construction than beginning with a reconstructed pagan pantheon.

The earlier proposal began with an eternal divine order and then placed race, ancestry, land, and the Germanic gods beneath it. The philosophy review suggests reversing that sequence. The theology should begin with the **Volk as the sacred subject**, struggle as the law of life, Providence as historical direction, the Führer as authoritative interpreter, and duty and sacrifice as morality. Germanic mythology then gives those principles names, persons, stories, and rites. fileciteturn7file1

So the mature SS religion is not primarily:

> We worship the old German gods and therefore support National Socialism.

It is closer to:

> We know the racial and spiritual law of life; the Germanic gods are the ancestral revelation of that law; National Socialism has restored it to historical power; and the SS exists to make that restoration hereditary.

That is a much more organic development from the historical SS. It also explains why archaeology, racial classification, marriage law, settlement, military service, welfare, and religious ritual all belong to the same institution.

The TIKhistory corpus itself needs to be used carefully. It is strongest when connecting race, collective identity, struggle, Providence, duty, leadership, and SS institutions. It becomes less reliable when it claims that Gnosticism, Hegelianism, Hermeticism, Odinism, and political religion are all different names for one hidden doctrine. fileciteturn6file1 For our purposes, however, the contested ideas can still supply **authorial building material**. We simply need to distinguish historical foundations from the theology Himmler constructs after victory.

## The revised metaphysical chain

The mature Himmlerite theology can probably be summarized in seven statements:

> **The world is living Order.**  
> **Order unfolds through Struggle.**  
> **Struggle tests and selects Form.**  
> **Form is carried through Blood.**  
> **Blood becomes historical in the Volk.**  
> **The Volk becomes conscious through Leadership.**  
> **The SS guards its continuity across generations.**

That is the theological spine. Everything else—Wotan, the ancestors, marriage rites, the Eastern estates, the Führer oath, racial files, funerals, and solstice festivals—explains or enacts one part of that chain.

It is not classical Norse religion. It is a modern racial-political metaphysics expressed through reconstructed Germanic religion.

# I. The divine ground: Order rather than a creator

The SS faith probably rejects creation from nothing by a wholly transcendent personal God. That would place ultimate authority outside nature, blood, history, and racial inheritance.

Instead, it teaches that existence is an eternal, living, self-differentiating order. A useful working name would be **the Allfather**, *Allvater*, although the inner doctrine might call it the World Ground or Eternal Order.

The Allfather is not merely an old man ruling from above. Nor is it a blind physical law. It is the divine ground from which:

- life;
- differentiation;
- sex;
- race;
- hierarchy;
- consciousness;
- struggle;
- death;
- and renewal

receive their reality.

This retains the earlier panentheistic element: the divine is present throughout the world but is not exhausted by any one creature, race, god, or historical state.

But the philosophy review adds an important correction. The divine order must be **dynamic**, not merely harmonious. Becoming, struggle, sacrifice, and overcoming are inherent within it. TIK’s recurring “law of struggle” is therefore not an optional political doctrine attached to the religion. It becomes part of the religion’s account of being itself. fileciteturn7file3

## Providence, fate, and will

The theology would probably distinguish three related ideas.

**Providence**, *Vorsehung*, is the directional unfolding of divine order through history. It does not determine every event mechanically, but peoples and great individuals can be called toward a historical vocation.

**Fate**, *Schicksal*, is the concrete situation in which an individual or people must act: the inherited body, family, age, war, territory, danger, or responsibility that cannot simply be wished away.

**Will**, *Wille*, is the conscious acceptance and fulfillment of that task.

A concise teaching might therefore say:

> Providence gives direction. Fate gives the task. Will gives the answer.

This also explains Hitler’s religiously ambiguous language. Christian listeners can hear divine Providence. SS intellectuals can understand the same word as the historical action of immanent racial order. The philosophy review correctly identifies that ambiguity as politically useful rather than merely confused. fileciteturn7file0

# II. The gods: real, but subordinate to the Order

The previous model’s monistic polytheism still works, but the gods need a clearer relationship to the racial worldview.

They are not interchangeable natural symbols available equally to anyone. They are the divine powers as apprehended through the inherited spiritual form of a people.

## Wotan

Wotan becomes the highest specifically Germanic revelation of the Allfather.

He represents:

- sovereign consciousness;
- hidden knowledge;
- inspired speech;
- command;
- sacrifice for wisdom;
- death accepted for a greater purpose;
- and the dangerous responsibility of seeing what ordinary men cannot.

TIK-47 supplies the strongest Odin interpretation, while TIK-50 supplies Rudolf Jung’s language of the German God or All-Father. Historically, identifying Hitler’s personal God exclusively with Odin goes beyond the evidence. But in this alternate setting, Himmler can deliberately make Wotan central to the **SS’s** developed theology without claiming that Hitler had secretly practiced a complete Odinist creed before the war. fileciteturn6file1

The official formula might be:

> **The Allfather is the eternal divine source; Wotan is the Germanic people’s highest ancestral knowledge of him.**

That lets Himmler retain both a philosophical unity and an actual Germanic deity.

## The other gods

Wotan alone cannot sustain a civilization. The religion needs divine forms for law, defense, household, fertility, cultivation, beauty, and boundaries.

A likely working hierarchy would include:

- **Tyr:** oath, law, courage, rightful office, and sacrifice for order.
- **Donar:** defense, strength, the protection of household and settlement, and power exercised openly.
- **Frigg:** marriage, motherhood, household continuity, and guarded knowledge of destiny.
- **Freyr:** cultivation, fertility, prosperity, ordered peace, and possession of land.
- **Freya:** desire, beauty, fertility, death, and the dangerous generative power of womanhood.
- **Heimdall:** boundaries, vigilance, distinctions among orders, and protection against infiltration.

These gods are neither equal sovereign creators nor merely literary metaphors. They are real personal manifestations of powers within the eternal order.

The ordinary settler may speak directly of Donar protecting the house. A senior theologian may explain that Donar is the Germanic personal manifestation of protective divine force. Both interpretations remain orthodox.

# III. Race as body, soul, and spirit

This is where the philosophy review gives the previous proposal its most important refinement.

The SS cannot ultimately define race as chemistry alone. If race is only blood type, skull measurement, or inherited physical appearance, its spiritual language becomes decorative. But if race is pure spirit, genealogy and reproductive policy become unnecessary.

The mature theology therefore defines race as an inherited **form**, or *Gestalt*, uniting three dimensions:

1. **Body:** physical inheritance, health, appearance, capacities, and reproductive continuity.
2. **Soul:** temperament, instinct, emotional character, aesthetic disposition, and inherited modes of relationship.
3. **Spirit:** the capacity to recognize higher order, create culture, accept sacrifice, command, and fulfill a historical vocation.

Blood is the bond among them.

It is not worshipped as a fluid. “Blood” is the religious and biological name for the process through which embodied form passes between generations.

This converts the philosophy review’s administrative chain—

> ancestry → presumed character → status → permitted role → reproductive value

—into explicit theology. An ancestry file is no longer only a state document. It is an institutional attempt to discern what form a person carries. fileciteturn6file0

## Why classification can remain flexible

This formulation also solves, within the system’s own reasoning, the contradiction between racial purity and imperial recruitment.

Documents, phenotype, measurements, language, conduct, and family history are **signs** of racial form. They are not individually infallible. A person may contain an inherited Germanic form that poor records or foreign culture have concealed.

Service does not magically turn a Russian, Dutchman, or Ukrainian into a German. Rather, the SS claims that exceptional service may **reveal** a previously hidden or suppressed Germanic nature.

The theological rule becomes:

> Classification does not create inherited form. It recognizes it, imperfectly.

That gives the SS room for:

- Germanic foreign volunteers;
- affiliated Nordic peoples;
- recovery of “lost” German blood;
- probationary classification;
- upward status for children;
- and endless bureaucratic appeals.

TIK-38’s discussion of residual Germanic blood and flexible foreign recruitment is especially useful here. The contradiction is not abolished. It is converted into an institutional doctrine of **recovery and recognition**. fileciteturn6file1

# IV. The Volk as the sacred social person

The review’s strongest ontological point is that the enduring reality is not the autonomous individual but the racially defined people. Individuals are temporary bearers of its life. fileciteturn6file0

The mature religion would define the Volk as a living communion consisting of:

- the ancestors who formed it;
- the living who presently bear it;
- and the unborn who will inherit the consequences of present conduct.

The Volk is therefore more than a population or state. It is a transgenerational person.

This does not mean the individual has no significance. It means that individual significance is relational. A man becomes fully himself by fulfilling an inherited office inside the larger life of the people.

Freedom is consequently redefined.

It is not freedom from inherited obligation. It is the self-command required to perform one’s duty without enslavement to appetite, comfort, fear, or private interest.

## Family

The family is the principal living organ through which the Volk reproduces itself.

Marriage joins inherited lines. Parenthood transmits biological and spiritual form. Education awakens what blood has made possible. Household order gives the child his first experience of rank, affection, duty, possession, and memory.

That makes marriage approval, fertility, medicine, maternity care, adoption, household welfare, and education inseparable from religion.

The philosophy review correctly identifies the historical foundation: the SS selected a man once as a recruit and again as a reproductive link in a future lineage. Marriage was already an organizational concern before a complete theology existed. fileciteturn7file2

## Property and lordship

The TIK economic argument is less important here as a dispute over whether National Socialism should be categorized as socialism. Its useful contribution is the distinction between formal title and functional control.

The SS religion would deny that property is an absolute private right against the Volk. A farm, estate, business, house, or hereditary office is held in stewardship.

An SS lord does not rule because whatever he owns is morally his to use without restraint. He rules because the Order has entrusted him with:

- land;
- households;
- production;
- dependents;
- security;
- and continuity.

His privileges are justified by office. His office is justified by service.

This produces a religious basis for a service aristocracy without simply restoring old nobility.

It also permits the SS to condemn a destructive lord. Arbitrary cruelty, waste, corruption, neglect of fields, or abuse that destabilizes an estate becomes a failure of racial stewardship—not a violation of equal human dignity, but a betrayal of entrusted order.

That distinction could support the more pragmatic Eastern estate model, although we should treat the current Eastern canon as a hypothesis to be retested rather than as a boundary on the theology.

# V. Struggle, sacrifice, and morality

The mature theology must distinguish struggle from unrestricted violence.

If every victor is right merely because he wins, the SS cannot condemn mutiny, criminality, corruption, private feuds, or destructive local commanders. Nor can it explain why an apparently victorious enemy might still be called decadent.

So struggle is understood as the process through which form demonstrates its capacity to endure, create, command, reproduce, and impose order.

Temporary success proves power. **Enduring ordered achievement proves worth.**

Struggle therefore includes more than war:

- mastery of appetite;
- physical training;
- military service;
- childbirth and parenthood;
- cultivation of difficult land;
- scientific discovery;
- technical construction;
- governing subject populations;
- resisting corruption;
- and maintaining inherited institutions across generations.

This is especially important after victory. Germany has won the war, but struggle cannot end without falsifying the religion’s philosophy of nature.

The SS therefore redirects struggle from emergency warfare toward:

- settlement;
- fertility;
- imperial administration;
- technological competition;
- racial preservation;
- education;
- frontier defense;
- and resistance to comfort and decadence.

The mature Reich is not supposed to abolish struggle. It is supposed to become capable of meeting struggle indefinitely.

## The good

The principal virtues become:

- duty;
- loyalty;
- courage;
- self-command;
- fertility;
- truthfulness within the Order;
- competence;
- stewardship;
- protection of dependents;
- willingness to sacrifice;
- and acceptance of rightful hierarchy.

## Evil

Evil is not primarily rule-breaking against a universal moral law. It is the willful dissolution, corruption, or betrayal of proper form.

Its characteristic expressions are:

- betrayal of oath;
- cowardice;
- sterility chosen for comfort;
- corruption of office;
- racial dissolution;
- private appetite placed above descendants;
- materialism;
- rootlessness;
- radical individualism;
- false universalism;
- exploitation that weakens the entrusted whole;
- and pity that refuses necessary struggle.

This gives the religion a reason to be severe while also giving it reasons to oppose uncontrolled sadism. Cruelty pursued for appetite rather than order is itself a form of degeneracy.

# VI. Racially bounded solidarity

The philosophy review’s discussion of welfare is important because it shows that internal generosity and external persecution are not opposites inside the worldview. They define the two sides of membership.

Within the accepted racial community, a person may be entitled to:

- family support;
- housing;
- medical provision;
- education;
- employment;
- pension;
- land;
- and protection from unauthorized exploitation.

These are not universal rights. They are reciprocal benefits of belonging.

The bargain is:

> **Status and security in exchange for obedience, service, fertility, and silence.**

The review identifies this as one of the conditions that makes a long-lived order durable. It does not need every person to be a mystic. It needs enough believers to lead, enough beneficiaries to defend the arrangement, and enough conformists to operate it. fileciteturn7file4

This also means hierarchy carries unequal reciprocal obligations. The superior is entitled to command, but he is expected to preserve the community entrusted to him. The subordinate owes service, but the Order owes him a place appropriate to his recognized status.

The result remains racial and coercive. It is not liberal equality, but neither is it pure atomized tyranny.

# VII. History as fall, awakening, and renewal

The TIK Gnosticism argument is most useful at the level of historical structure.

The SS faith can develop a three-age history without needing a literal intellectual descent from Joachim of Fiore or ancient Gnostic sects.

### The First Age: ancestral wholeness

The early Aryan peoples possessed a clearer unity of:

- blood;
- gods;
- household;
- land;
- warrior authority;
- sacred knowledge;
- and productive order.

Migration divided the original people into historical branches. Each preserved part of the ancient inheritance.

### The Second Age: estrangement

The peoples became separated from inherited form through:

- racial mixture;
- urban rootlessness;
- foreign religion;
- universal empire;
- Christianity;
- liberalism;
- Marxism;
- financial abstraction;
- individualism;
- and historical defeat.

This is not merely moral decline. It is the loss of conscious alignment between blood, spirit, institution, and history.

### The Third Age: awakening

National Socialism restores the German people to consciousness of its inherited vocation.

Hitler is the Awakener. Victory proves that the awakening has entered effective history. Eastern conquest gives it land. The SS makes it hereditary.

But this third age is not a world without struggle. That would contradict the fundamental law of life.

Its goal is:

> not the end of history, but the permanent restoration of a people capable of meeting history.

This is an immanent salvation doctrine. Redemption occurs in the organization of the people, not through escape from the world.

## Why it is not actually Gnostic

Classical Gnostic systems tend to treat the material world as a prison or corruption from which the spiritual self must escape. The SS system does the reverse:

- body is sacred inheritance;
- blood carries form;
- nature reveals order;
- reproduction continues spirit;
- land is necessary;
- and political history is the field of fulfillment.

The system can still be called “gnostic” in a loose political sense because an initiated elite claims knowledge of the hidden law of history and seeks salvation within history. But metaphysically it is closer to **racial immanentism** than Gnosticism.

So we should take from TIK:

- initiatory knowledge;
- immanent salvation;
- millenarian renewal;
- and an elite that interprets history.

We should reject:

- a secret uninterrupted ancient genealogy;
- radical world-denial;
- and the claim that the label “Gnostic” explains the theology by itself.

# VIII. The Führer as interpreter of Providence

The philosophy review correctly emphasizes that the Führer principle is more than organizational command. The Führer is presented as the person capable of perceiving and articulating the authentic will of the Volk. fileciteturn7file3

In the mature SS theology, the Führer does not create racial truth. He recognizes and enacts it.

The chain becomes:

> Divine order gives the Volk a vocation.  
> Providence directs that vocation through history.  
> The Führer perceives and articulates it.  
> The movement organizes it.  
> The SS guards and reproduces it.

## Hitler

Hitler is not Wotan incarnate and not a god.

He is the unique **Awakener**, the first modern German who correctly perceived the people’s historical situation and united will, race, state, and destiny into effective action.

His victory confirms his insight, although it does not make every utterance an eternal metaphysical proposition.

After his death, his words become increasingly canonical because no successor can reproduce his personal authority. That will create disputes over editions, context, authentic interpretation, and which statements govern changed conditions.

## Himmler

Himmler is the first **Keeper of the Order** and the systematizer of its faith.

His doctrinal authority comes from three sources:

- his command of the SS;
- his patronage of racial and ancestral research;
- and Hitler’s authorization of the SS as guardian of the racial future.

He is not an independent prophet above the Führer. His task is to explain the eternal and racial meaning of the mission Hitler has historically opened.

That distinction is probably what makes Hitler willing to permit a coherent SS religion.

## The SS

The SS is the initiated racial, political, and religious guardianship of the German people’s future.

It is not merely a priesthood because it also governs, settles, fights, polices, educates, and reproduces families. Nor is it merely an aristocracy because its claim to rank depends upon ideological and hereditary vocation.

Its religious purpose is to make victory **transgenerational**.

# IX. Knowledge, science, and the closed worldview

The religion needs an epistemology: how does it know that its claims are true?

It would probably recognize four sources:

1. **Nature:** biology, medicine, heredity, behavior, and demographic observation.
2. **Ancestral memory:** mythology, language, folklore, archaeology, and inherited custom.
3. **Historical judgment:** survival, victory, creative achievement, and the fate of peoples.
4. **Authoritative interpretation:** the Führer and the Order synthesize evidence into doctrine.

The Ahnenerbe becomes central because it joins all four. It studies actual evidence, but under an answer chosen in advance. Its role is not free inquiry. It is to determine how newly discovered material fits the established racial history.

Contradictions do not necessarily cause abandonment of doctrine. They produce:

- subcategories;
- hidden-ancestry theories;
- exceptional classifications;
- accusations of corrupted science;
- distinctions between biological and spiritual inheritance;
- and appeals to higher interpretation.

The review’s table of contradictions is particularly valuable here. A durable ideology does not have to remove every contradiction. It can assign each side to a different office, territory, audience, or legal category. fileciteturn7file4

That is how Himmler can produce a coherent theology without producing an intellectually open theology.

# X. Antisemitism as demonology

The previous theological model did not give sufficient attention to antisemitism. The philosophy review makes clear that it is not simply another rung in a racial hierarchy.

Within National Socialist ideology, Jews are cast as the personalized principle of whatever dissolves organic racial order:

- abstraction;
- rootlessness;
- financial domination;
- Marxism;
- liberal individualism;
- universalism;
- racial mixture;
- and the separation of intellect from blood and land.

This creates a distinction between two kinds of out-group.

A Slav, African, Asian, or other population may be classified as inferior, foreign, exploitable, subordinate, or conditionally useful within a hierarchy.

The Jew is imagined as **anti-hierarchical in a deeper sense**: the enemy who dissolves the existence of authentic peoples as such.

That is the theology’s demonology. It permits persecution and removal to be represented not merely as conquest but as purification of the world’s organic order.

Even where Jewish communities have been killed, expelled, or reduced to near absence, the “Jewish spirit” remains an ideological category that can be projected onto:

- liberal churches;
- cosmopolitan intellectuals;
- finance;
- Marxism;
- foreign culture;
- or internal SS critics.

This is also why the religion remains permanently mobilizing after victory. The concrete enemy can disappear while the alleged dissolving principle remains everywhere.

# XI. Christianity and other religions

The mature SS confession would probably reject Christianity doctrinally while tolerating it politically outside the Order.

Its principal objections would be:

- a universal God standing above racial distinction;
- equal spiritual destiny for all peoples;
- salvation independent of blood and political order;
- the moral primacy of the weak;
- celibacy as a higher state;
- suspicion of worldly power;
- and the Church’s claim to an authority not derived from the Volk.

But the SS does not need to claim that Christianity contains no truth. It can say Christianity appropriated and distorted older Aryan truths:

- sacrificial death;
- resurrection;
- divine sonship;
- sacred kingship;
- communal loyalty;
- and victory over corruption.

A Germanized Christian may therefore be treated as transitional or partially awakened, while the full SS confession rejects Christian universalism.

This supports a divided religious field:

- broad providential civil religion in the Reich;
- continuing Catholic and Lutheran institutions under political limits;
- party racial orthodoxy;
- and a more explicit SS ancestral faith.

The SS can therefore possess a coherent religion without the whole German nation converting at once.

# XII. Death and ancestral continuity

The attached review provides less firm historical material on the afterlife than it does on race, struggle, duty, and leadership. So this remains a more openly authorial construction.

The strongest fit is not unrestricted reincarnation. It is **ancestral continuation**.

At death, the person’s body returns to the land, while his soul enters the ancestral communion of his people. His form continues through:

- descendants;
- name;
- household memory;
- institutional achievement;
- the land he held;
- and the Order he served.

Exceptional reappearance through a bloodline can be accepted as a mystery. Himmler and inner-circle mystics may believe that particular heroic souls return more distinctly. The ordinary believer is not required to identify literal past lives.

The heroic dead, particularly those who knowingly sacrificed themselves for the future of the Volk, possess a more active place in the divine order. They may be understood as gathered around Wotan or as forming the invisible retinue of the Order.

The opposite of salvation is not eternal torture. It is severance:

- exclusion from memory;
- loss of name;
- extinction of lineage;
- expulsion from the Order;
- and dissolution into historical nothingness.

This makes genealogical erasure and dishonorable burial genuine religious punishments.

## What the integrated theology now looks like

The earlier model survives, but with a different hierarchy.

The gods remain real. Ancestors remain present. Blood carries inherited form. Land is sacred through settlement. Service defeats individual transience. But these ideas are now organized beneath a clearer National Socialist metaphysics:

> **Race and Volk are the sacred subject.**  
> **Struggle is the law.**  
> **Providence gives direction.**  
> **The Führer interprets.**  
> **Duty and sacrifice define goodness.**  
> **The gods reveal the order in Germanic form.**  
> **The SS makes the order hereditary.**

That is coherent enough for Himmler to formalize during the victory years.

It also does not require every SS man to become an occult scholar. The religion can possess two levels:

**The common confession** teaches ancestry, family, struggle, duty, gods, Führer, land, service, and the dead.

**The inner Order teaching** explains the Allfather, Wotan, racial form, Providence, the three ages, spiritual-biological inheritance, and the SS’s role as the conscious guardian of history.

Functionally, the faith becomes real wherever the SS controls:

- marriage;
- birth;
- schooling;
- career;
- land;
- status;
- oath;
- burial;
- and the official memory of the dead.

The attached reference’s most useful warning remains in force: the exotic material has to be attached to institutions. Otherwise it becomes spectacle. fileciteturn7file14

The revised working conclusion is therefore:

> **The mature SS faith is a racial immanentist religion in which an eternal divine order unfolds through struggle, becomes embodied in unequal racial forms, enters history through peoples, becomes conscious through leadership, and is preserved across generations by an initiated hereditary Order. Wotan is the specifically Germanic face of sovereign divine consciousness, not a solitary creator or a secret synonym for Hitler. Salvation is the historical restoration and indefinite continuation of the Volk, while individual fulfillment consists in duty, sacrifice, family, office, and incorporation into the ancestral community.**

That gives us a theology substantial enough to work backward from. The remaining chronology would no longer ask when Himmler acquired random beliefs. It would ask when he settled each link in this chain, who helped him formulate it, what Hitler authorized, and which institutional crises forced an abstract doctrine into enforceable law.

Yes. The reference guide drew a useful analytical distinction and then pushed it too far.

Political religion, personal theology, ritual, occult practice, public rhetoric, institutional loyalty, and philosophy of history are not interchangeable kinds of evidence. But they are **causally connected parts of one religious ecosystem**. A public speech can draw on a private metaphysical belief; a ritual can teach a political doctrine without stating it; an administrative practice can harden a metaphor into law; and an archaeological claim can retroactively change how an older ceremony is understood.

The correct rule is therefore:

> **Distinguish the layers when assessing evidence, but connect them when reconstructing development.**

The playlist’s own organization points in that direction. Its treatment moves repeatedly among racial ontology, Providence, esoteric ancestry, duty, the Führer principle, ritual, settlement, and command practice. The cumulative argument depends upon those subjects reinforcing one another rather than standing in sealed compartments. fileciteturn7file1

That means our previous reconstruction was still too clean. It produced a coherent theology, but it did so partly by flattening the messier intellectual inheritance that Himmler would actually be trying to systematize.

# A braided inheritance, not a straight genealogy

The line from Joachim to Hegel to Marx to Hitler is not an apostolic succession in which each man hands an unchanged secret doctrine to the next. But neither is it merely a set of accidental analogies.

The better image is a **braided river**.

Ideas split, recombine, pass through several intermediaries, change vocabulary, and sometimes return in a form their earlier authors would reject. Direct reading is only one form of influence. Others include:

- shared intellectual vocabulary;
- indirect transmission through popularizers;
- political movements borrowing structures without the original theology;
- Wagnerian art making philosophical ideas emotionally intelligible;
- Theosophy placing European philosophy inside an esoteric racial history;
- Ariosophy Germanizing and racializing that esotericism;
- and National Socialism converting the result into political institutions.

The principal contributions would look something like this.

**Joachim of Fiore** supplies a historical imagination organized around successive ages and the expectation that an old religious-political order will be superseded by a qualitatively different age.

**Hegel** supplies history as a meaningful process in which spirit becomes conscious through conflict, contradiction, institutions, and historical peoples.

**Marx** secularizes and materializes much of that process. Alienation, revolutionary struggle, collective emancipation, historical transformation, and salvation within history survive even when class is later displaced by race.

**Wagner** converts abstraction into mythic experience. Sacrifice, corruption, heroic redemption, blood, erotic destiny, the fallen order, and the total work of art become emotionally inhabitable rather than merely philosophical.

**Blavatsky and Theosophy** supply root races, cosmic cycles, secret initiates, comparative religion, lost ancestral wisdom, and the idea that mythology preserves encoded racial-spiritual history.

**List, Lanz, and the Ariosophic milieu** turn that wider occult system toward runes, Germanic antiquity, priestly racial elites, Nordic origins, and a specifically German restoration.

**Rudolf Jung** provides a much more directly political bridge: spiritual anti-materialism, the *Volksgemeinschaft*, social duty, the German or All-Father conception, and national renewal.

**Hitler** gives the complex an effective historical center. Providence, will, struggle, racial destiny, leadership, and the political transformation of the Volk become actionable rather than speculative.

**Himmler** then converts the worldview into an order: ancestry, initiation, marriage, children, settlement, research, sacred sites, police power, and hereditary office.

The influences are therefore real without being mechanically linear. TIK’s error, where it occurs, is not necessarily noticing the connections. It is sometimes treating every connection as the same kind of connection.

For AltWWII, that is useful rather than fatal. Himmler is not reconstructing an objectively pure historical lineage. He is selecting material from a connected intellectual world and declaring that the connections reveal an underlying tradition.

# Revising the Gnostic element

Our previous formulation—“racial immanentism rather than Gnosticism”—was too categorical.

The SS faith can be material, biological, territorial, and Gnostic at the same time, provided its dualism is more complicated than “spirit good, matter evil.”

## The central dualism

The mature faith probably contrasts:

> **conscious Form** against **blind or disordered substance**

Matter is not intrinsically evil. A healthy body, fertile soil, inherited blood, a cultivated estate, and a technically ordered state are all good because spiritual Form has organized them.

What is evil or lower is matter detached from proper Form:

- appetite without duty;
- wealth without service;
- population without racial order;
- technology without spiritual direction;
- mixture without hierarchy;
- intellect without blood;
- and economic production without a higher racial purpose.

This gives the theology a qualified dualism.

Spirit must rule matter, but it does not escape matter. It incarnates itself through matter. Blood is sacred because it is the vessel through which spiritual Form enters biological and historical existence.

That is closer to what Himmler needs. A radically anti-cosmic religion would undermine fertility, embodiment, racial biology, settlement, and land. A merely biological religion would fail to justify initiation, secret knowledge, Providence, spiritual hierarchy, and Wotan.

## Gnosis as awakening

The SS understanding of *gnosis* would not be the discovery of an abstract fact hidden in a book. It would be a transformative recognition:

> The initiate realizes that he is not an autonomous individual but the temporary bearer of an ancient racial-spiritual Form.

That knowledge changes what he believes himself to be.

Before initiation, a man experiences ancestry, duty, sex, work, and political obedience as external circumstances. After awakening, he is supposed to understand them as expressions of his deepest being.

This creates a hierarchy of knowledge:

- ordinary Germans participate in the Volk largely through inherited custom;
- party members understand its political doctrine;
- SS members consciously accept its racial and historical meaning;
- the inner Order understands the cosmic structure beneath it.

The SS therefore resembles a Gnostic elect without needing to copy one ancient sect’s terminology.

Its secret knowledge concerns:

- the origin and division of the Aryan peoples;
- the spiritual content carried by blood;
- correspondences among Germanic, Vedic, Iranian, Greek, and other traditions;
- cycles of racial awakening and decline;
- the relation between Wotan, Providence, and the Führer;
- reincarnation or ancestral recurrence;
- and the SS’s role in directing historical evolution.

## The complexity should remain institutional

A coherent religion does not require one explanation of everything at every level.

The mature faith should probably contain three concentric teachings.

### The people’s teaching

The exoteric teaching is concrete:

- honour the gods and ancestors;
- marry well;
- have children;
- keep the household;
- work;
- defend the land;
- obey rightful authority;
- remember the dead;
- and leave the Volk stronger than it was received.

Most SS families can live this teaching without understanding Hegel, Hermetic cosmology, or Indo-European philology.

### The Order teaching

The formal SS doctrine explains:

- race as body, soul, and spirit;
- blood as inherited Form;
- struggle as the law of becoming;
- Providence as historical direction;
- the Führer as interpreter;
- the gods as ancestral manifestations of divine powers;
- and the SS as the conscious hereditary guardian of the Volk.

This is what appears in schools, marriage instruction, officer formation, and approved theological texts.

### The inner teaching

The elite teaching is more speculative and probably not completely uniform.

It contains competing but bounded schools concerning:

- whether Wotan is a literal divine person, an emanation of the All-Father, or the highest consciousness of the Germanic racial soul;
- whether reincarnation preserves individual personality;
- whether cosmic history proceeds through fixed ages;
- whether polar or Hyperborean traditions preserve actual ancestral memory;
- whether runes are conventional symbols or manifestations of deeper cosmic forms;
- and how far non-German Aryan traditions retain authentic revelation.

Himmler’s achievement is not eliminating those schools. It is defining what they may disagree about.

They may differ over the ontology of Wotan. They may not deny that the Germanic gods are authentic revelations of Aryan spiritual reality.

They may differ over literal reincarnation. They may not deny ancestral spiritual continuity.

They may differ over cosmological details. They may not deny racial hierarchy, Providence, Führer authority, or the SS’s vocation.

That gives the religion the complexity of an actual theological tradition rather than the simplicity of an ideological pamphlet.

# How archaeology changes the faith

The SS religion would not be created once in 1947 and then frozen. Archaeology continually changes what the Order believes its ancestors actually did.

More precisely, archaeology changes what the SS **claims it always meant**.

## The first phase: a textual and romantic religion

During the 1930s and 1940s, SS reconstruction rests heavily on:

- the Eddas;
- sagas;
- place names;
- runic material;
- Tacitus;
- Adam of Bremen;
- Saxo;
- medieval descriptions of conversion;
- folklore;
- Wagner;
- völkisch scholarship;
- and already-known burials, weapon deposits, ship graves, and sacred landscapes.

The resulting faith is likely too literary and too centralized. It imagines something closer to a Germanic church with temples, a recognizable pantheon, a priestly order, and standardized rites.

That is partly because Himmler is searching for a functional replacement for Christianity. He naturally asks Christian-shaped questions of fragmentary pagan evidence.

Where is the pagan church? What is its creed? Who are its priests? What is the proper wedding rite? What is its canonical calendar?

Historical Germanic religion may not have answered those questions in that form.

## The second phase: the sacrificial ancestors

Postwar discoveries would strengthen the sacrificial side dramatically.

Tollund Man was found in 1950, and Grauballe Man in 1952. Both were Iron Age bog bodies who had died violently; museums and scholars have long debated execution, punishment, and ritual sacrifice, with sacrifice remaining a major interpretation. citeturn608401search8turn323869search4

For the SS, the evidentiary qualifications would matter much less than the visual force of the finds.

A preserved ancestral body with a noose or cut throat would be treated as physical confirmation that the old religion demanded real offerings. The fact that these bodies predated the Viking Age by many centuries would not weaken the case. SS scholars would present them as evidence of deep Germanic continuity beneath later Norse forms.

The Skedemosse excavations of 1959–62 would reinforce this further. The site contained weapons, gold, large animal deposits, ceremonial meals, and remains attributed to dozens of humans in a sacrificial wetland used over a long period. citeturn323869search11turn323869search15

That would cause a major doctrinal revision.

Early SS paganism might treat sacrifice mainly as heroic metaphor. By the early 1960s, the Order’s theologians have archaeological grounds—however selectively interpreted—for saying that sacrifice was a normal means of reciprocity between ancestors, gods, rulers, and communities.

## The third phase: the hall, feast, and sacred estate

Later archaeology would push the religion away from the model of a detached pagan church and toward the **magnate’s hall as the center of cult, politics, law, economy, and hospitality**.

Tissø’s Viking significance first came dramatically to light in 1977 with the discovery of its large gold ring. Later excavation revealed a magnate complex with cult buildings, ritual feasts, and offerings of weapons, jewelry, tools, animals, and possibly people in the surrounding landscape. citeturn608401search4turn608401search3

In our timeline, much of this interpretation matured after the current AltWWII endpoint. But an enormously funded Ahnenerbe, operating across Scandinavia and the German-controlled East, could bring similar “central-place” archaeology forward.

This would have a major effect upon SS society.

The Order ceases imagining that every settlement needs a pagan parish church. Instead, the estate becomes the religious unit.

The SS lord is not necessarily a priest, but he is the ritual host. His hall connects:

- government;
- justice;
- feasting;
- gift distribution;
- military command;
- ancestor memory;
- marriage;
- and sacrifice.

That complements the service-aristocratic direction of the Eastern SS far more naturally than a modern congregational model.

## The fourth phase: a less tidy paganism

Continuing archaeology would reveal that pre-Christian northern religion was not one completely standardized church. Cult houses, sacrificial places, burial rites, regional gods, household practices, sacred waters, ritual meals, and local traditions varied significantly. Modern museum summaries explicitly emphasize that the surviving evidence points to many practices rather than one uniform ecclesiastical structure. citeturn784190search3turn784190search21

The SS response would not be to abandon uniformity. It would distinguish **ancestral diversity** from **modern Order unity**.

The official argument becomes:

> The ancestors possessed the truth in locally divided form. The Order has reunited its scattered fragments consciously.

So every new contradiction becomes useful.

Different sacrificial animals prove regional adaptation. Different gods prove functional differentiation. Different burial rites prove that spiritual Form can inhabit several outward customs. Christian influence in late sources proves corruption but also survival beneath foreign language.

Archaeology therefore makes the theology richer without making the institution less controlling.

# Would the SS hold blóts?

Almost certainly.

In fact, *blót* is likely to become the SS’s most important general word for sacrificial worship.

But it should not be reduced to slaughter.

The historical concept is better understood as reciprocal offering: something valuable is transferred to divine or ancestral powers, often in connection with ritual feasting, libation, vows, and communal distribution. Archaeological and literary evidence associates blót with animals, objects, food, drink, weapons, precious goods, and in some contexts human beings. citeturn784190search0turn608401search3

The SS would standardize several levels.

## The household blót

The **Hausblót** is performed by an SS family or lineage.

Typical occasions include:

- birth;
- naming;
- marriage;
- departure for service;
- return from war;
- inheritance;
- death anniversaries;
- solstices;
- and the foundation of a new household.

The offerings are modest: drink, grain, bread, flowers, fire, an ancestral object, or part of a household meal.

The purpose is not primarily to request miracles. It acknowledges that the family received life, land, and inheritance from powers beyond the individual.

## The kin or estate blót

The **Sippenblót** or estate blót joins several households beneath an estate, settlement, regiment, or district.

This is where animal sacrifice becomes normal.

The animal is not merely destroyed. Its death sanctifies a communal feast. The meat is distributed according to household, rank, office, or service. Toasts and vows are made to gods, ancestors, founder figures, and the future generations of the settlement.

This has a strong political function.

The lord provides the sacrifice and feast. The retainers renew loyalty. Families display status. Children see hierarchy embodied in seating, portions, speeches, and honours. The subject population may provide labour and food without being admitted to the inner rite.

The blót therefore becomes simultaneously worship, welfare distribution, political assembly, and public accounting of rank.

## The Order blót

The **Ordensblót** is restricted to SS initiates.

It occurs at Wewelsburg, major officer schools, battlefield memorials, founding graves, Eastern settlement centers, and perhaps selected sacred landscapes.

It concerns:

- oath;
- death;
- command;
- hidden knowledge;
- the renewal of office;
- and the bond among the living and heroic dead.

An animal offering may be included, but the decisive offering is usually the participants’ own lives symbolically placed at the disposal of the Order.

This is where the SS’s political oath becomes sacramental.

The initiate is not only promising obedience. He is acknowledging that his body, descendants, property, skills, and death belong within a transgenerational mission.

# Would human sacrifice be theologically legitimate?

The most plausible answer is:

> **Yes in principle, rarely as an explicit rite, and never as an ordinary private prerogative.**

By the 1950s or 1960s, a substantial portion of the theological elite would probably accept that human sacrifice had been a legitimate ancestral practice. Textual traditions, Odin’s association with hanging and death, bog bodies, sacrificial wetlands, and human remains at ritual sites would give them more than enough material to reach that conclusion. Archaeological interpretation remains contested in real scholarship—violent death, double burial, execution, and unusual deposition do not automatically prove sacrifice—but the SS would prefer the interpretation that confirmed the recovered ancestral religion. citeturn784190search7turn784190search4

But legitimacy in principle does not mean free practice.

The mature theology would likely distinguish four forms of human offering.

## Self-offering

The highest and most public form is voluntary sacrifice of oneself.

This includes:

- death in battle;
- accepting a mission with little chance of return;
- dying to protect one’s household or men;
- refusing to betray the Order under interrogation;
- and devoting an entire life to service.

The SS can call this human sacrifice openly because no separate ritual killing is required.

This becomes the preferred doctrine:

> The true lord offers himself before he offers another.

That formula also disciplines the elite. A commander cannot celebrate sacrifice while preserving himself from every danger.

## Representative or hereditary offering

A person may offer his future rather than his immediate life.

An SS family gives:

- sons to military and administrative service;
- daughters to approved marriages and medical or educational office;
- land to an Order foundation;
- descendants to settlement;
- and the family name to continuing duty.

This is less dramatic than death but more useful to a hereditary order.

In normal SS teaching, it is probably described as the mature replacement for primitive sacrifice. The ancestors offered one life at an altar; the new Order offers generations.

## Judicial sacrifice

This is the form most likely to produce actual human killing with religious significance.

A person already condemned as:

- an oath-breaker;
- traitor;
- murderer of SS personnel;
- rebel leader;
- desecrator of a sacred site;
- or irreconcilable enemy

may be executed in a way that is ritually interpreted as an offering to the gods, the dead, or the restored order.

Formally, it is a lawful execution.

Esoterically, it is a sacrifice.

That distinction lets the state practice human offering without publicly admitting that a pagan priesthood is killing captives for divine favor. It also keeps authority with the state and SS judiciary rather than with local celebrants.

A rebellion suppressed near a major memorial date could therefore produce executions that ordinary files describe as security punishment while inner Order records describe as repayment of blood debt or cleansing of violated land.

## Explicit *Mannblót*

The purest form—killing a person solely as an offering—is the most controversial.

The inner doctrine could recognize it as lawful under exceptionally narrow conditions:

- existential danger to the Volk;
- consecration or refoundation of a uniquely sacred site;
- fulfillment of an extraordinary vow;
- or direct authorization by the Führer and Reichsführer-SS.

Private initiative would be forbidden.

An estate lord who kills a captive in a personal blót has not demonstrated religious zeal. He has usurped the sovereign authority to dispose of life and created a private cult. That threatens the Order’s monopoly over theology, justice, and violence.

So even theologians who accept *Mannblót* would insist:

> No man may offer what is not his to give.

That leaves two theoretically pure victims.

One is a **volunteer**, most likely an elderly or mortally ill SS man who consciously gives himself. This would be treated as the highest possible offering, but it would also be exceedingly rare.

The other is a person whose crime is said to have forfeited his life to the community. In practice, this collapses back into judicial sacrifice.

## Would they sacrifice Germans?

Involuntary sacrifice of a healthy, racially approved German would probably be theologically possible only in the most extreme inner doctrine and institutionally almost prohibited.

The contradiction is straightforward. The SS claims to preserve valuable German blood. Destroying it arbitrarily would violate the reproductive purpose of the Order.

A willing German can offer his own life because self-sacrifice proves mastery and vocation. A condemned German traitor can be offered because he has severed himself from the Volk. But seizing a loyal German merely because a god demands blood would undermine the Order’s claim to protect its own hereditary community.

Subject peoples and enemy captives would face a much lower barrier. Even there, however, routine sacrifice would be administratively wasteful, politically embarrassing, and dangerous to central authority.

# What probably happens in practice

The first postwar decade would be the most unstable.

Some radical SS circles would experiment with rites that central doctrine has not yet settled. Remote commanders may reinterpret executions, anti-partisan reprisals, deaths of prisoners, or the dedication of new settlements as sacrifices. A few may perform secret explicit *Mannblóts*.

Himmler’s central office would initially investigate rather than immediately condemn them. He would want to know whether the rite was:

- historically grounded;
- properly authorized;
- racially appropriate;
- politically controllable;
- and useful to the Order.

Over time, the center would probably suppress most local experimentation.

Not because it rejects sacrifice, but because sacrifice is too important to leave to amateurs.

The mature arrangement becomes:

- animal blót is common;
- household and estate offerings are normal;
- self-sacrifice saturates SS morality;
- executions can carry hidden sacrificial meaning;
- explicit human sacrifice remains a recognized inner possibility;
- and unauthorized human sacrifice is treated as murder, indiscipline, or private priestcraft.

That is more complex than either extreme.

The SS is not secretly performing mass human sacrifice at every solstice. Nor has it reduced sacrifice to harmless theatrical symbolism. It has built a religion in which real blood remains meaningful, while the state carefully controls whose blood can be given, by whom, and under what interpretation.

# Revised working model

The SS faith should now be described as a **Germanic-Aryan initiatory religion with Gnostic, Hermetic, völkisch, historical-dialectical, racial-biological, and political-religious layers**.

Its unity does not come from reducing those sources to one proposition. It comes from making them answer the same set of questions:

- Who is the real human subject? The Volk.
- What carries it? Blood and inherited Form.
- Why does history move? Struggle and Providence.
- How is its direction known? Gnosis and Führer interpretation.
- How is it enacted? Duty, hierarchy, settlement, and sacrifice.
- How is it transmitted? Family, initiation, education, and the Order.
- How does it worship? Blót, oath, feast, memorial, ancestral communion, and service.
- What is salvation? The Volk becoming conscious of its nature and enduring through history.
- What is damnation? Dissolution, sterility, betrayal, loss of name, and separation from ancestral continuity.

And the archaeology never merely illustrates this theology. It continually modifies it.

A bog body changes the doctrine of sacrifice. A magnate’s hall changes the understanding of priesthood. A cult building changes sacred architecture. A weapon deposit changes the understanding of objects. A contradictory burial creates another theological school.

That is the degree of complexity we want: not random confusion, but a living and internally contested religion whose institutions keep absorbing new material into an authoritative account of what the ancestors, supposedly, had always known.
